Name: Distillation
Author: SheeEttin
Description:
Adds a craftable still to make alcohol from some fruits and vegetables. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿, which requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿.

[size=5]Installation[/size]

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url], then install this mod by extracting it into your Mods folder so that it writes into CustomFarmingRedux.

Currently this mod does not work with Stardew Valley Package Manager. It must be installed manually (but it's easy enough to remove later on).

[size=5]Use[/size]

Craft a still from the crafting menu, then put in one of the following fruits or vegetables to turn them into alcohol:

[list]
[*]Potatoes - becomes vodka
[*]Yams - becomes rum
[*]Cactus fruit - becomes tequila
[*]Holly - becomes gin
[*]Corn - becomes whiskey
[/list]
Normally you'd make rum from sugarcane and/or molasses and gin from juniper, but Stardew Valley doesn't have those so ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

These products work like the other alcohols in the game (specifically, pale ale). They probably work the same for gifts, too.

This mod is not tested in multiplayer, but probably works.
